declarations.name: instGroupExtension
declarations.assessment: Actual group instance over arbitrary additive commutative groups, inverse(-v,-z+β(v,v)); associativity uses both linearities. This is a construction, not an axiom for an unspecified operation.

declarations.name: vertexProjection
declarations.assessment: Actual multiplicative homomorphism to Multiplicative V from the vertex coordinate; no finiteness or graph conditions asserted.

declarations.name: edgeForm
declarations.assessment: Actual nested additive homomorphism with value v(head e)w(tail e) in ZMod2. Tail/head are arbitrary maps; the application supplies the simple ordered graph separately.

declarations.name: supported
declarations.assessment: Actual Subgroup on coordinate pairs with zeros off J/internal edges. Both product and inverse closure use vanishing at a missing edge endpoint.

declarations.name: support_intersection
declarations.assessment: Equality of those literal support subgroups under lattice meet and set intersection, for arbitrary sets. It does not claim they are generated by markers.

declarations.name: power_gap
declarations.assessment: Natural powers of2 have the successor gap; no conversion from residue type indices to powers is formalized.

omissions: generation of supported subgroups by the markers
coset geometry and full automorphism or correlation groups
residue induction and orbit-stabilizer index product
trust: Lean4.32.2 kernel with bound mathlib source/pins and cached dependency objects. GAP and SmallGroups are separate from Lean.
